//: Core Web Vitals budget, enforced in CI.
The thresholds are deliberately achievable rather than aspirational: a gate
nobody can pass gets disabled within a fortnight, and a disabled gate is
worse than none because it looks like coverage. These are the numbers this
app should hold without heroics, and they are meant to be tightened as it
gets faster rather than loosened when it gets slower.
Only anonymous routes are audited. Everything else needs a session, and a
Lighthouse run carrying a real credential is a report nobody can share.
The share page is the one that matters most anyway — it is the page people
who have never heard of this product will land on.
